claims.statement: The page /openwiki/configuration/profiles.md accurately describes the threshold schema and the three profiles (mengram, yt-summarizer, openwiki) as defined in the threshold YAML files and the scripts/thresholds.py file.

scripts/thresholds.py::DEFAULTS supplies defaults for all 11 threshold keys (min_param_b=28, min_context_length=40000, min_max_output_tokens=8000, buffer_pct=5, require_structured_output=True, require_tools=False, min_uptime=None, max_latency_ms=None, min_candidate_pool=3, allowlist=[], hardallowlist=[]) applied whenever a YAML omits a key.

scripts/filters.py::filter_candidates applies thresholds in order: free-only filter, hardallowlist inclusion, allowlist inclusion (with stderr warnings on feature failure), parameter floor (min_param_b never buffered or relaxed), soft thresholds with buffer, candidate-pool relaxation reducing buffer_pct by 1 toward 0 while below min_candidate_pool, then post-probe filters.

Models without a parseable size token (Nb pattern) in their OpenRouter id are excluded by min_param_b unless listed in allowlist or hardallowlist; min_param_b itself is a fixed floor never relaxed during pool relaxation.

allowlist models bypass min_param_b and context/output thresholds but still must pass require_structured_output and require_tools (excluded with a stderr warning if not); hardallowlist models bypass min_param_b, context/output thresholds, and both feature requirements entirely with no warning.
Candidate-pool relaxation reduces buffer_pct by 1 toward 0 while allowed+candidates < min_candidate_pool, stopping when the pool is large enough or buffer_pct reaches 0.

Profile-specific threshold values: mengram min_param_b=28/context=40000/output=8000/structured_output=true/tools=false/pool=3; yt-summarizer 14/32000/2000/false/false/3; openwiki 70/128000/16000/false/true/2.
